final: WITH player_hand_awards AS (SELECT pa.player_id, p.bats, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM player_award AS pa JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = pa.player_id GROUP BY pa.player_id, p.bats), hand_counts AS (SELECT bats, COUNT(*) AS player_count FROM player_hand_awards GROUP BY bats), total AS (SELECT SUM(player_count) AS total_players FROM hand_counts), hand_shares AS (SELECT hc.bats, hc.player_count, CAST(hc.player_count AS REAL) / total.total_players AS share FROM hand_counts AS hc CROSS JOIN total), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS mean_share FROM hand_shares) SELECT hs.bats, hs.player_count, hs.share, hs.share - avg.mean_share AS difference FROM hand_shares AS hs CROSS JOIN average_share AS avg WHERE hs.share > avg.mean_share
